content:
Interesting phenomenon living through my first hurricane: I didn't have any connectivity beyond SMS and a tiny sometimes trickle of data for about two days. "FB Lite" choked lol. So I kept hearing from friends thousands of miles away telling me how bad the photos and video looked while I was sitting at home 15 miles from the worst damage and wouldn't see any of that footage for another day or so. They were better informed than I was...at least visually. It was a little disorienting.

Also: People were almost literally wandering around my neighborhood going, WIFI GIMME WIFI. Yes, the wifi zombies emerged quickly.

#Lowell #Hawaii
